headline: Juba Dal leader's body sparks protest in Jessore, accused's house set on fire
summary: Following the discovery of a Juba Dal leader's body, angry protesters took to the streets of Jessore. The demonstration escalated, leading to the alleged arson of a house belonging to an accused individual.
details: A Juba Dal leader's body was discovered in Jessore, prompting immediate outrage among his supporters. The incident quickly led to a large-scale protest in the area.

During the demonstration, tensions escalated, and protesters reportedly set fire to the house of an individual accused in connection with the leader's death. Law enforcement agencies are investigating the circumstances surrounding both the death and the subsequent acts of violence.
